Atomic product screenshots and campaign graphics: supplied company assets and locally recorded sample-app demonstrations. Suggested credit: Courtesy of Atomic / Abstract Machines.
Portraits: supplied company materials. Suggested credit: Courtesy of Abstract Machines. Individual photographer names were not supplied. Portraits retain their original resolution.
Sample-app photographs remain part of the illustrated product view; they are not supplied as standalone stock photography.
Atomic symbol: canonical supplied SVG geometry, with the same colour converted to sRGB for compatibility. Wordmark: outlined Manrope 750, matching the approved campaign treatment.
Manrope: SIL Open Font License, included under assets/Manrope-OFL.txt.
Audio: previously generated and approved ElevenLabs narration and instrumental music. Audio copied from the approved videos, with no new generation requests.
Opening covers: rendered from the approved composition in widescreen, square and vertical formats. All use “Big idea? Make it real.” with the Atomic logo and website.
Editorial edition: updated 30 October 2026, using the approved product gallery, three evergreen launch-film formats and matching covers.
